claims.subject: Monstrous Mask of the Forsaken Pariah

ambiguities.details: Required levels preserved exactly; no name-only mapping to the later ability entries or correction against graft-guide prefix progression. Face, mask and skin entries supply no mechanics here.

Small and moderate are qualitative source labels, not numeric bonuses. Repeated names at different printed levels remain separate claims. Dexterty spelling retained; no canonical stat or item identity assigned.

limitations: Shared archived contributor provenance is not independent corroboration.
Only pet-graft prose blocks 126 through 185 reviewed here; other backlog pages and tables remain pending.
No operative values, canonical client IDs or historical era inferred.
